Causality by Abstraction: Symbolic Rule Learning in Multivariate Timeseries with Large Language Models is the closest match: it uses LLMs to generate formal, verifiable symbolic causal rules for delayed effects in multivariate time series, with temporal operators and delay semantics [1]. The rules are refined for consistency and tested through reconstruction, causal-encoding ablations, and generalization to unseen output trends [1].

Other papers address LLM-assisted causal discovery or temporal causal models, but their abstracts do not describe learning logical rules for time-series causality [3, 4, 6].
